settings.title: Global settings
settings.accountLink: Your personal settings are in My account.
settings.templateHint: Use / to separate folders. Placeholders: {placeholders}. Put {album} in the folders and {title} or {track} in the file name. Names are stored in lowercase, without accents or spaces and with the catalogue id; what you see comes from the tags.

tags.title: Tags
tags.hint: The first one joins the names that are shown. If you change this list and some file lacks the ARTISTS tag, set the same in Navidrome.

settings.thresholdHint: Monthly listeners (or subscribers, when YouTube Music does not publish listeners). Related artists above this figure get an “Import discography” suggestion.
